Bonfire Analytics | Senior Data Scientist, Staff Data Scientist | New York, NY (FiDi) | ONSITE / HYBRID | Full-time | $140K-$225K + 0.05%-0.2% equity

- Bonfire is a small, seed-stage team in NYC. We build provider and claims analytics that healthtech companies (digital health, medical device and biotech) use to take their products to market: who treats the patients they serve, where the volume is, and which providers to focus on first.

- What you'd do: own analytical problems end to end across billions of medical and pharmacy claims, from scoping the question with a customer to the answer they act on. You'd work directly with me (co-founder and CTO) and our customers, with AI tools at the center of how you work.

- We'd especially like to hear from people who were early at a small startup or have started something themselves. Experience with claims, provider or payer data is a plus, not a requirement.

- Senior: 3+ years in data science, $140K-$190K. Staff: 5+ years, leads data science and helps hire the team, $160K-$225K. Both include 0.05%-0.2% equity.

- On-site or hybrid in our FiDi office. We can't sponsor visas.

Apply: https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/bonfireanalytics?utm_source=hn
